content.value: A binary communication channel carries data as one of the two types of signals denoted(12) [CO3] by 0 and 1. Owing to noise, a transmitted 0 is sometimes received as 1 and a transmitted 1 is sometimes received as a 0. For a given channel, assumed a probability of 0.95 that a transmitted 0 is correctly received as a 0 and a probability of 0.90 that a transmitted 1 is correctly received as a 1. In that binary communication channel it is observed that out of 100 transmitted signals, type of signal 0 is 60. If a signal is transmitted then determine the probability of (i) 0 was transmitted given that 0 was received, (ii) total error.
